name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea have massed forces at their border after reported clashes near Badme on 12–13 Nov
state: Reuters reported on 18 Nov that Ethiopia and Eritrea have massed forces along their border; ACLED said Ethiopian drones struck likely Eritrean positions near Badme on 12 Nov and the armies clashed the next day, which Reuters could not confirm (Al-Monitor). Fighting between Ethiopia's government and Tigray rebels has continued since September (Critical Threats). Neither government has confirmed interstate fighting and no later clash was found as of 23 Nov, so the Alert is unconfirmed and Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia, including areas near the Eritrean border and Tigray. Check FCDO travel advice before travelling to the Horn of Africa.
rubric_hit: Significant deterioration in a conflict not tracked elsewhere = Watch; interstate war unconfirmed
